title: 第一章 军校消息
slug: 民国我包国维黄埔一期
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

2026年3月。

这一天是教资考试时间，师范生包国维奔赴考场，一眼望去，基本女生。三月初春时节，风景甚好，考场学校内有一片人工湖，颇具匠心。拱桥上行走的包国维一个不慎脚滑，跌落了湖中。

“快看，有人跳湖了，跳湖了！”

“这不是还没考吗，考不过有什么紧要的了。”

“是个男生，估计想当显眼包，湖里游泳呢。”

跌入湖中的包国维一开始还使劲的扑腾了两下，没小会儿湖面就平静了。

1924年初。

江南的一座小镇上。秦府。

只三天，包国维就把一切给弄清楚了，在这个世界他也叫包国维，就是那个用斯丹康头油的包国维。上辈子也是这个名，因为这个名字，二十一世纪被朋友笑话了好长一段时间。

适应能力不错，三天时间就接受了自个的处境。是志诚中学的一名中学生，学费高昂竟然到了三十块大洋每学期，不是一般人家可以承受的住的。

老包省吃俭用着想要望子成龙，但小包太不争气竟然还留级了。

现在住在秦府，秦家是当地的望族。老包是秦府的长工，主家给的待遇还不错，从来没有苛待过。

三天的时间，独属于穿越人士的两个外挂也被他琢磨透了，一个是空间，长宽高各占一米的随身空间。另一个外挂能力，过目不忘。这个能力是在看报纸的时候发现的，只是把报纸给看了一遍，仅仅一遍，上面的内容便全部都

也是在那份报纸上看到了一则大消息，知道黄埔军校要招生了，就在三月末，而现在是二月初。

黄埔第一期招生啊，无论如何都是要去的，第一期，将官云集，男人，哪个不想当将军，这个机会若是错过了，民国岂不是白来了。

黄埔招生考场有两个，时间是在下个月月底，时间大把的，不急。一个考场是在广州。另一个考场是上海，他在浙江的一个小镇上，距广州很远，但距离上海刚好一百公里左右，坐船过去可朝发夕至，有准备时间。

还得想法弄点钱，穷家富路。他爹老包，不过是秦府的一个下人，月薪在七块到十块之间，已经很不错了，但要养一个读书人，日子便紧巴巴的。几十年下来，就只有过三件大袄子。

过些天就要开学了，包国维现在捧着几本书在看，主要是看上头的繁体字，多亏有着过目不忘的能力，消化的快，能全给

一旁的老包瞧见了，眼睛里泛光，笑的脸上的褶皱跟菊花一样灿烂。搁之前，他儿子可从来没看过书。

瞅了一会儿就离开了，去做事情。现在公历二月，离新年还有几天。

秦家是大宅院，有好些个做事的。

“老包，你知道吧，志诚中学不让学生过年了。你们国维就要上学喽。”

“怎么年也不过，就要去学堂啊。”

“不兴过年，这是新态，洋学堂是跟洋人学的嘛。洋学堂出来的，将来啊要做大官呐。”

Page (1/3)

March 2026.

This day was the teaching qualifications examination time. Bao Guowei, a normal school student, rushed to the examination room. At first glance, he looked like a girl.In the early spring of March, the scenery is very beautiful. There is an artificial lake in the examination room school, which is quite original.Bao Guowei, who was walking on the arch bridge, accidentally slipped and fell into the lake.

"Look, someone jumped into the lake, jumped into the lake!"

"Isn't it true that we haven't taken the test yet? If we fail, it won't matter."

"It's a boy. He probably wants to use it as a conspicuous bag and swim in the lake."

Bao Guowei fell into the lake and flopped hard twice at first. After a while, the lake calmed down.

Early 1924.

In a small town in Jiangnan.Qin Mansion.

In just three days, Bao Guowei figured everything out. In this world, he is also called Bao Guowei, the same Bao Guowei who uses Stankang scalp oil.He also had this name in his previous life. Because of this name, he was laughed at by his friends for a long time in the 21st century.

He has good adaptability and accepted his situation within three days.She is a middle school student at Zhicheng Middle School. The tuition fee is so high that it costs 30 yuan per semester. It is not something that ordinary people can afford.

Lao Bao was frugal in order to hope that his son would become a successful child, but Xiao Bao was so unsatisfied that he even repeated the grade.

Now living in Qin Mansion, the Qin family is a prominent local family.Lao Bao was a long-time employee of the Qin Mansion, and the treatment given by his master was pretty good, and he was never treated harshly.

In three days, he also figured out two plug-ins that are unique to time-travelers. One is space, which is one meter in length, width and height.Another plug-in ability, photographic memory.This ability was discovered when I was reading a newspaper. I just read the newspaper once, and all the contents on it were covered.

I also saw a big news in that newspaper. I knew that Whampoa Military Academy was going to enroll students. It was at the end of March, and now it was the beginning of February.

No matter what, you have to go to the first phase of recruitment in Huangpu. In the first phase, generals gather. Man, who doesn’t want to be a general? If this opportunity is missed, the Republic of China will be in vain.

There are two admissions examination rooms in Huangpu. The dates are at the end of next month. There is plenty of time, so there is no rush.One examination center is in Guangzhou.The other examination center is Shanghai. He is in a small town in Zhejiang, far away from Guangzhou, but about 100 kilometers away from Shanghai. You can take a boat there and arrive in the morning and evening, so you have time to prepare.

We still have to find ways to get some money, so that poor families can become rich.His father, Lao Bao, was just a servant of the Qin Mansion. His monthly salary was between seven and ten yuan, which was pretty good, but if he had to raise a scholar, life would be tight.Over the past few decades, there have only been three large coats.

School will start in a few days. Bao Guowei is currently holding a few books and reading them, mainly reading the traditional Chinese characters on them. Thanks to his photographic memory, he can digest them quickly and can read them all.

Old Bao on the side saw it, his eyes were shining, and the wrinkles on his smiling face were as bright as chrysanthemums.Before this, his son had never read a book.

After watching it for a while, he left and went to do some work.It's February on the Gregorian calendar, and there are still a few days until the New Year.

The Qin family is a big house with many people working there.

"Old Bao, you know, Zhicheng Middle School doesn't allow students to celebrate the New Year. You, Guowei, are going to school."

"I'm still young, so I have to go to school."

"It's not popular to celebrate the New Year. This is a new trend. Foreign schools learn from foreigners. Those who come from foreign schools will be high officials in the future."
